title: Jupyter Server Nbmodel
description: Execution of the notebook cells on the Jupyter Server.

outputRecovery.title: Recover the outputs over HTTP
outputRecovery.description: Read the outputs of a running cell from the execution request as well as from the collaborative document, and resume the polling of a request after a page reload. Turn this on when outputs are saved by the server but never appear in the notebook, which happens with a collaborative history the browser cannot integrate. It makes this extension a second writer of the shared document; the collaborative updates alone are used otherwise.
